title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression, also known as L2 regularization, adds a penalty term to the loss function to prevent overfitting. This penalty term is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the coefficients.

title: Effect of Regularization on Solution Uniqueness
text: Regularization techniques like Ridge regression can help in obtaining a unique solution even when the design matrix is not full rank.

title: Understanding the Model
text: The model Wesley uses is: $$y_{hat,i}=\theta_0+\theta_1 {x_{i1}}^3+\theta_2 \ln\left(x_{i2}\right)$$. This is a linear model in terms of the parameters $$\theta_0$$, $$\theta_1$$, and $$\theta_2$$.
